name: Base of the ramp to the main boxwork ridge
identification_quote: the rover parked near the edge of a smooth, sandy stretch at the base of a ridge that leads to the most prominent and complex network of boxwork structures seen so far
image_caption: Left Navigation Camera, sol 4598 (13 Jul 2025), taken at this waypoint. Credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech.

name: Top of the ridge, start of the main boxwork region
identification_quote: we successfully climbed the 11-meter ramp (about 36 feet) and have arrived at the top of the ridge and the start of the main boxwork region
image_caption: Left Navigation Camera, sol 4600 (15 Jul 2025), looking along the ridge from the ramp, about 11 m before the ridge top (site 117 drive 2370). Credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech.
